tips.scale: Replicas share the traffic. More replicas add capacity and survive a container restart, at a proportional cost.
tips.limits: Hard caps on CPU and memory for each container. A container that hits its memory cap is restarted.
tips.autoscale: Adds or removes replicas when CPU or memory stays above or below the targets you set.
tips.sleep: Stops the app after a quiet period and wakes it on the next request, so idle apps cost nothing.
tips.budget: A monthly spend cap. What happens at the cap (warn or stop) is up to you.
tips.labels: Free-form key and value tags. Use them to group apps, filter lists and track cost.

static.noContainer: No container, so no CPU or memory. Storage and traffic are what matter here.

health.scoreTip: One line per area: deploys, alerts, domains and TLS, secrets and backups. Anything not passing is listed first.
health.probesTip: Readiness gates a deploy cutover. Liveness restarts a hung container. Each is an HTTP request or a command run inside the container.
